thread:
carl-enginfra: Heads up — we just saw a scrub job (janitor) fail on eu-north3 causing a handful of NVMe devices to flip readonly. GPU attaches started failing ~3m ago.

maria-sre: seeing same alerts. outage impact: ~12 pending GPU allocs blocked, a couple of running jobs hit i/o errors and restarted.

leo-oncall: ops-bot reported: `device nvme0n1: medium error, metadata checksum mismatch` then `mounted read-only`.

anika-storage: digging into janitor logs: last run tried to bulk-delete stale mmap'd tempfiles and hit a kernel EIO while doing ftruncate -> scrub aborted mid-transaction.

carl-enginfra: exact error paste from janitor: 
```
2026-03-21T10:02:11Z ERROR janitor cleanup failed: writeback error EIO on /mnt/scratch/tn-123/tmpfile-XX, aborting
stacktrace: cleanupWorker -> deleteTempfile -> fsync -> -5
```

anika-storage: after abort, our cleanup worker left partially-zeroed blocks; smartctl shows reallocated sectors bumped on 3 devices. Not classic HW failure but high write amplification + concurrent scrub.

maria-sre: consequence: kubelet saw device readonly -> detached PVs -> gpu-controller saw attach error -> pod stuck Pending. Affected nodes: eu-north3-{12,14,21}.

leo-oncall: I throttled future janitor runs in eu-north via toggle: `infractl jobs set-concurrency janitor eu-north 1` to stop more damage.

anika-storage: good call. Immediate mitigation steps I'm proposing: 1) pause janitor, 2) escalate scrub to low-level block scrub (non-destructive) on affected nodes, 3) coordinate node reboots if device remains RO, 4) force remap/reassign ephemeral with new scratch pools.

carl-enginfra: agree. Also: enable fallback routing from eu-north to eu-west for GPU provisioning for critical customers while we heal. Can we flip routing quickly?

maria-sre: we have a policy switch: `routing.toggle_region_fallback eu-north eu-west true` — but that routes only Reserved and Host tiers, not Private. Might help for PLG traffic.

leo-oncall: I pushed a canary to routing and watched one test gpu-attach succeed in eu-west within 30s. Will keep monitoring.

anika-storage: running `badblocks -sv /dev/nvme0n1` on node 12 now (low-priority). If badblocks finds nothing, we can try remount with `ro->rw` via `echo 1 > /sys/block/nvme0n1/force_ro_clear` and then slow scrub. If hardware shows >X reallocated we swap the instance.

carl-enginfra: what's the cost impact if we start remapping nodes out and routing to other regions? heads up to finance/sales?

maria-sre: short term cost hit: ~3-5% increase in cross-region egress + temporary more expensive instances if we use dedicated fallback pool. Estimate ~ $1.2k/day until stable. Should notify account reps for top customers.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0321-1221 - eu-north NVMe readonly + GPU attach failures. Severity: SEV2.

anika-storage: update from node 12 badblocks: finish ~8m, found 2 non-fatal sectors remapped. `fsck` reports no filesystem corruption, kernel still flagged read-only after truncation events. Plan: try controlled remount and background scrub on node 12 only. If it holds, roll to 14 then 21.

leo-oncall: I'm marking nodes Cordon+Drain for pods that are restartable (low-priority) and setting `gpu-controller` to skip attaching to flagged nodes.

carl-enginfra: change for janitor: add in-policy backoff and per-device bytes-per-second cap. Janitor should never spin up >2 concurrent deletes on the same disk. Also add a mid-run checkpoint so we can resume instead of aborting.

anika-storage: will open PR for janitor throttling and checkpointing, but patch won't land until tomorrow. For immediate safety I set `janitor.concurrencyPerNode=1` and `janitor.deleteBurstBytes=64MB`.

maria-sre: assignment: anika (lead) for remediation of storage, leo for routing/fallback, carl for janitor change and rollout. I'll own stakeholder comms.

leo-oncall: monitoring queries: watch `nvme.*.replaced_sectors`, `node.provision.pending_gpu`, `janitor.errors{node}`. I'll add a dashboard tile and alert if pending_gpu > 5 for >5m.

anika-storage: quick note — if we end up needing to reprovision nodes, prefer cold-swap to new hosts instead of disk remap if reallocated sectors >5. We'll prefer public images with our kernel build that has improved writeback pacing.

carl-enginfra: thanks. Once janitor PR lands, let's schedule a canary run in us-west on a small pool to validate no regressions.

maria-sre: incident timeline will be updated in INC ticket. Current status: mitigation toggles applied, janitor throttled, 1 node remounted RW and scrub in progress. Impact contained to eu-north3, critical customers routed away.

leo-oncall: ongoing — I'll keep the channel updated every 10m or on any change. :white_check_mark:

carl-enginfra: filing follow-ups: (1) janitor resiliency work item, (2) scrub rate controls, (3) post-incident cost report for fallback traffic. Adding to sprint board.

maria-sre: thanks team. If anyone wants to take a shadow pager for the night, ping me.

leo-oncall: I'll stay on for the next 2hrs then hand off to night shift.

ops-bot: INC-2026-0321-1221 updated — mitigation in progress.

maria-sre: closing loop: priority next-steps in ticket and postmortem scheduled tomorrow 0900 UTC.
